title: Warm Velvety Middle Eastern Boudin Blanc Maqluba
description: A sweet and velvety Middle Eastern dish featuring boudin blanc, perfect for kids and diabetic-friendly, served in a maqluba form. This dish is a unique twist on traditional maqluba recipes.

ingredients.name: boudin blanc
ingredients.notes: use a diabetic-friendly boudin blanc recipe

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pot, bring 4 quarts of water to a boil and cook the boudin blanc for 10 minutes.
While the boudin blanc is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the cauliflower to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked boudin blanc to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
In a large maqluba pot or a deep baking dish, create a layer of cauliflower.
Add a layer of boudin blanc on top of the cauliflower.
Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of cauliflower on top.
Cover the pot or dish with a lid or aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
